labeling: The amount of RPIA in the WT PKR complex was less abundant than in the kinase-dead PKR complex as assessed by spectral counting
ptm: fixed carbamidomethylation; variable oxidation of methionine; variable acetylation at the N-terminus; variable phosphorylation of serine, threonine, and tyrosine residues

Fixed modifications were applied for cystine derivation (carbamidomethylation), and variable modifications were tested for oxidation of methionine, acetylation at the N-terminus, and phosphorylation of serine, threonine, and tyrosine residues.
